name: Take-Two Interactive Software, Inc.
blurb: Take-Two Interactive Software, Inc. is a leading developer, publisher, and marketer of interactive entertainment. The company is best known for its Grand Theft Auto, NBA 2K, and Red Dead Redemption franchises. It operates through labels Rockstar Games and 2K, holding a dominant position in the premium console and PC gaming market.
recent: In the past month, Take-Two's stock rose about 12.66% as anticipation builds for the upcoming Grand Theft Auto VI launch. CEO Strauss Zelnick described the launch as both exciting and terrifying, citing higher development costs and intense investor expectations. A recent SEC filing also revealed Vanguard holds just over 7% of the company's stock.
